name: Koori no Tsuki
source:
Handyman member of "SHUTTLE SHIFT" heads to a Western-style building in response to a request. He is to dwell in its strange atmosphere and learn the secrets exchanged in its depths.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-may-2004-carnival.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
“SHUTTLE SHIFT”的维修工成员接到委托，前往一座西式建筑。他将在诡异的氛围中生活，并了解隐藏在深处、彼此交换的秘密。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-may-2004-carnival.html]vndbreview[/url]]
